name: @plusguard/gsap-connector
description: Connects GSAP's ScrollTrigger to the page, with or without Lenis: runs Lenis on GSAP's ticker, keeps ScrollTrigger in step with every scroll, and refreshes the triggers when the page changes height. Takes your own GSAP — no second copy. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
